query:
SELECT
            r.code,
            r.name,
            COUNT(*) AS "pending_count!"
        FROM project_submissions ps
        JOIN projects p ON p.id = ps.project_id
        JOIN roles r ON r.id = p.role_id
        WHERE ps.status = 'pending_review'
        GROUP BY r.id, r.code, r.name
        ORDER BY r.name
